knownFindings.issue: Sustained direct movement uses delayed guest coordinates and can reverse while holding a constant direction.
knownFindings.requiredFix: Transmit normalized direction and derive a finite destination from authoritative host coordinates.

technicalReview.scope: Read-only implementation risk assessment and planning probes; technical review is not director approval.

risks.finding: Solo UI requires two heroes; one-hero combo is unavailable and combo missions remain in the quest pool. Existing campaign completion evidence uses previous rosters.
risks.proposal: Approve online-only combo UI/mission policy and separately validate single-hero campaign balance.

risks.finding: Peer-provided spec is used directly at host start; the picker alone does not enforce exactly one valid hero per participant.
risks.proposal: Validate the received roster at start boundaries, including count, valid ID, displayed selection and distinct heroes.

risks.finding: Leave is queued from multiple paths, transfers heroes/towers/gold, and left-owner fallback allows remaining player to control an extra hero.
risks.proposal: Approve permanent-departure termination or an explicit alternative. Preserve temporary reconnect grace, remove all implicit two-hero takeover routes.

risks.finding: 30-second room reservation exists but physical-phone background/reconnect is unverified; prototype sustained movement uses stale guest positions.
risks.proposal: Host-relative input direction/stop and actual mobile/PC WAN recovery verification.

risks.finding: Legacy arrays remain intact through merge; changing the default hero count does not migrate saved two-hero rosters.
risks.proposal: Normalize selection without resetting currency, unlocks, purchases, upgrades, skins, campaign or quest history.

risks.finding: Local sessions stand in for co-op in many regression and progression tools.
risks.proposal: Replace active local-entry tests with explicit rejection, and migrate shared co-op coverage to real host/guest sessions rather than delete it.
